resistance_spec.directionality: source_subtree_deletion plus target_subtree_insertion when root kind or arity changes; otherwise recursive canonical-child alignment

primary_question: For semantically equivalent representations in the certified finite universe, does semantic equivalence imply equivalence of transition geometry?
null: semantic equivalence implies equal full outgoing resistance profiles
alternative: there exists a semantically equivalent pair with unequal outgoing resistance profiles
secondary_observation: there exists a semantically equivalent pair with different thresholded reachable sets
exclusions: claim that the resistance relation is intrinsic or uniquely correct
claim_ceiling: A positive result supports only that semantic identity does not necessarily determine transition accessibility under this frozen structural resistance relation.
